She tucked the note into her coat pocket, climbed the spiral stairs, and trimmed the wick until the beam turned slow and bright across the churning, salt-kissed waves.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市没有白日的喧嚣，柏油路面还留着夜露的湿凉，街灯拖出橘色长影，斜斜铺在空无一人的人行道上。偶尔有环卫作业的车辆缓缓驶过，扫过落叶的声响格外清晰。路边的早餐店已经亮起暖黄的灯，蒸笼掀开时腾起的白汽飘到街面，和远处高楼缝隙里漏出的将亮未亮的天色揉在一起。连风都放轻了脚步，生怕惊醒还在酣睡的人。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a big task is made of tiny, identical smaller versions of the same task, just like the nested wooden dolls you might have seen on a shelf.\n- First, you solve the absolute smallest, easiest version of the task — the tiniest doll right in the center — because that part needs no extra work.\n- Once you have that small answer, you build it back up step by step to solve the whole big task, never going in circles forever."}
